name: day-13-url-slug-generator
description: CLI local TypeScript para el generador de slugs del día 13.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md ROADMAP.md docs/*.md assets/*.md assets/*.html src/environment.d.ts src/slug.ts src/cli.ts tests/slug.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md ROADMAP.md docs/*.md assets/*.md assets/*.html src/environment.d.ts src/slug.ts src/cli.ts tests/slug.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
